# rsSectionSweep · Section sweep

> Module: Geometry / Surfaces

[← Back to command index](/en/commands/)

**Function**: Surface (Brep) generated by sweeping the cross-section along the trajectory, with real-time orange wireframe preview

> Screenshots and videos may show a Chinese-language interface. Labels and control positions can vary by Rhino or RSTool version.

**Run**: Enter `rsSectionSweep` in the Rhino command line (command-line interaction).

**Workflow**:

1. Command line input rsSectionSweep
2. Select the trajectory line (multiple selections possible)
3. Select section line (multiple selections possible)
4. Select section line reference point
5. Select sweep type (free twist/top trend/aligned surface)
6. If aligning surfaces, additionally select reference Brep
7. Toggle mirror/rotate 90 degrees option in preview
8. Press Enter to generate a surface

**Parameters**:

| Display name | Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sweep type | SweepType | list |  | 0=FreeForm/1=Top trend (RoadLike)/2=Align surface (AlignToBrep) | Selected by the GetString option, one must be selected; when the type is AlignToBrep, reference Brep must be selected |
| mirror | Mirror | toggle | false |  | Mirror section (OptionToggle in confirmation phase) |
| Rotate 90 degrees | Rotate90 | toggle | false |  | Click option during confirmation phase, each +90° cycle (0/90/180/270), controlled by RotationCount |

**Notes**: Sweep type must be selected; Rotate is a loop option that accumulates 90° per click; Align to Surface mode requires an additional selection of Reference Brep.
